caption:
What Allah told the mother of Musa when she was afraid

Allah inspired the mother of Musa to cast her baby into the river when she feared for him, and told her not to fear or grieve, for He would return him to her. Sometimes trust means letting go and leaving it with Allah.

Surah Al-Qasas 28:7

Send this to a mother who is worried about her child

#storyofmusa #tawakkul #muslimmom #quranreels

Recitation: Maher Al-Muaiqly
alt_text: We inspired the mother of Moses, “Suckle him; but when you fear for him, cast him into the river, and do not fear or grieve. We will surely return him to you, and will make him one of the messengers.” (Surah Al-Qasas 28:7)
